svg.data-what: the human body from the front, its main organs in place: the left side of the body is on the right of the picture

path.data-what: the skin over the whole body, seen from the front
the aorta, the great artery leaving the heart and running down the back of the trunk
the iliac arteries, where the aorta divides toward the legs
the inferior vena cava, the great vein bringing blood back up to the heart
the right kidney, against the back wall, a little lower than the left
the left kidney, against the back wall
the ureters, carrying urine from each kidney down to the bladder
the spleen, on the left behind the stomach: it filters the blood and holds lymphocytes
the pancreas, lying across the back of the abdomen: digestive juices and insulin
the oesophagus, carrying swallowed food down to the stomach
the left lung, two lobes, with a notch where the heart sits

g.data-what: the trachea, the windpipe, held open by rings of cartilage, dividing into the two bronchi

path.data-what: the thyroid gland, in front of the windpipe at the base of the neck

g.data-what: the heart, between the lungs, its tip toward the left

path.data-what: the liver, under the right side of the diaphragm
the gallbladder, under the liver, storing bile

g.data-what: the stomach, under the left side of the diaphragm
the large intestine, framing the small one: ascending, transverse, descending colon

path.data-what: the appendix, a small blind tube off the start of the large intestine

g.data-what: the small intestine, coiled in the middle of the abdomen, where food is absorbed

path.data-what: the bladder, low in the pelvis, collecting urine from the kidneys
